name: Дидим
fact: Parent of the 160-m moonlet Dimorphos struck by NASA's DART on 2022-09-26 — the first demonstration of kinetic-impactor planetary defense. Didymos itself remained intact as a 780-m S-type observing the binary period change.
bio: S-type near-Earth binary discovered 1996, with the 160-m moonlet Dimorphos in an 11.9-hour orbit at 1.2-km separation. Classified as a chondritic body — LL-class silicate composition, common in the inner main belt. ESA's Hera mission (launched 2024) will arrive 2026 to survey the post-impact system in detail.
